Five corrections from a live review, and the Folders card now mentions the per-set schedule that arrived in v8.6.1.

## 🎨 Design

- **The What's New window loses its two rules and its top close button.** A line under the title and another above the footer is hierarchy drawn with a border, which this app's design language avoids, and the padding already separates the three regions; the confirmation window lost the same pair in v8.5.4. The header's close button went with them, because the footer already carries one and two controls doing the same thing read as a choice between two answers rather than one answer offered twice. Keyboard entry is unchanged: the window still opens with a close button focused, now the one that remains.
- **The sidebar has a sign-out row**, above the view toggle, and only when a login password is set. An instance without one has nothing to sign out of. It clears this browser's session and returns you to the login screen; Settings keeps the "sign out everywhere" variant that also invalidates other browsers.
- **The Security card is called Password.** Once the second factor moved into a card of its own, the name promised more than the card contained.
- **The 2FA card's enable button is the width of its own words**, not the width of the card.

## 📖 Documentation

- **The Folders card now says that a set can carry its own schedule** ([#199](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/bombvault/issues/199)). That arrived in v8.6.1, but the switch enabling it lives in another card and until it is on the folder rows show no schedule editor at all, so the feature was invisible from exactly the screen where you would look for it.

## 🌐 Translations

- The Password card's new name in all 42 languages, and the Folders hint's extra sentence likewise. In German the second factor is now "Zwei-Faktor-Authentifizierung" rather than "-Anmeldung"; every other language already said authentication.
